verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 description, idempotent requests via `requestId`, and 409 conflict protection. Personal access tokens authorize scripts against it, and `cafe api <path>` reaches any endpoint. The CLI covers repositories, pull requests, stacks and issues with `--json`, and an MCP server works on issues and pull requests. However, no source states that every UI action has an API equivalent, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. That probe only checked guessed locations, so it does not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or endpoint coverage listing, a reachable published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of API breadth (e.g., stack landing, rulesets, settings via API).
